description: This file defines the GoteoCore class implementing the ExtensionInterface for the Goteo project. It provides various utility methods like request handling, session, cookie, configuration, user information, menu retrieval, and role checks, serving as a core extension component in the system.

classes.name: GoteoCore
classes.description: Core extension class providing utility methods for request handling, user management, configuration, messaging, and role checks within the Goteo system.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the static request object.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the static request object, creating a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the extension with provided arguments.

methods.name: provideFilters
methods.description: Returns available filters (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: provideFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of functions that this extension provides.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Returns the application's debug status.

methods.name: asset
methods.description: Generates a URL for a given asset.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Retrieves messages, optionally auto-expiring.

methods.name: errors
methods.description: Retrieves error messages, optionally auto-expiring.

methods.name: get_cookie
methods.description: Fetches a cookie value by name.

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Fetches a session variable.

methods.name: is_ajax
methods.description: Checks if the current request is an XMLHttpRequest (AJAX).

methods.name: is_pronto
methods.description: Checks if the request is a 'pronto' AJAX request, considering debug mode.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Retrieves a GET query parameter or all if no parameter specified.

methods.name: get_post
methods.description: Retrieves a POST parameter or all if no parameter specified.

methods.name: has_query
methods.description: Checks if a GET query parameter exists.

methods.name: has_post
methods.description: Checks if a POST parameter exists.

methods.name: get_uri
methods.description: Gets the current request URI.

methods.name: get_pathinfo
methods.description: Gets the path info from the request.

methods.name: get_querystring
methods.description: Gets the query string from the request.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value.

methods.name: get_main_url
methods.description: Retrieves the main URL for the site.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for the site, potentially localized.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current user object from the session.

methods.name: get_user_menu
methods.description: Retrieves the user menu.

methods.name: get_sidebar_menu
methods.description: Retrieves the sidebar menu.

methods.name: get_user_location
methods.description: Retrieves the location of the current user or IP-based location.

methods.name: get_main_menu
methods.description: Retrieves the main menu.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Gets a formatted currency representation.

methods.name: get_currency
methods.description: Gets the current currency.

methods.name: has_role
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific role in a node.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin rights.

methods.name: is_module_admin
methods.description: Checks if the user is admin of a specific module.

methods.name: is_logged
methods.description: Checks if a user is logged in.

methods.name: is_master_node
methods.description: Checks if the current node is the master node.
